content: function  Eth_Init  [SWS_CP_ETH_00002]   void Eth_Init(const Eth_ConfigType* CfgPtr); Initializes the Ethernet MAC controller, DMA rings, and PHY link interface. Ethernet Interface (EthIf) EthIf coordinates multiple Ethernet controllers and transceivers, abstracts VLAN tagging, and routes frames to upper network stacks.
